# dsh-sdk-mcp v0.6.0-rc.1

## Release preparation

- GitHub repository: `https://github.com/ELRdn/DSH-SDK-MCP.git`
- Candidate tag: `v0.6.0-rc.1`
- npm package: `dsh-sdk-mcp@0.6.0-rc.1`
- Intended npm dist-tag: `next` (never `latest` for this RC)
- Publish workflow: `.github/workflows/publish-npm-rc.yml`
- Publish authentication: npm Trusted Publishing through GitHub Actions OIDC
- GitHub environment: `npm-publish`
- Long-lived npm publishing token: intentionally not configured

## Gate status

This is a prepared release body only. No GitHub release was created, no tag was
pushed or moved, and no npm publish/dist-tag operation was executed.

Phase 6.1 host gate is currently blocked:

- Codex: `FAILED` because non-interactive MCP approval rejected destructive
  calls before the real delegate continuation path completed.
- Claude Code: `FAILED` because its OAuth session expired before the first model
  turn.

The public release must remain unpublished until both host rows are rerun as
`VERIFIED` with the full provider-backed path.

## Trusted Publisher configuration to perform later

After the package exists on npm and the host gate is green, configure the npm
Trusted Publisher with these exact values:

```text
Provider: GitHub Actions
Owner: ELRdn
Repository: DSH-SDK-MCP
Workflow filename: publish-npm-rc.yml
Environment: npm-publish
Allowed action: npm publish
```

Then run the workflow manually with `version=0.6.0-rc.1` and
`dist_tag=next`. Do not add `NODE_AUTH_TOKEN` or another long-lived publish
secret to the repository.
